name: netprobe
description: The network modules on the machine: code banks over one data bank, linked at load. Only means anything at kernel.netprobe = 1.
command: modload bsdnetd bsdnet0 bsdnet1 bsdnet2 bsdnet3; sleep 3; dmesg | tail -6

screen_contains: bsdnet: netintr second pass, same entry

requires.reason: the probe C is compiled into the network modules only at kernel.netprobe = 1
